cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Rank Everything
cards.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I pressed that printer button after you. Put my troubleshooting first in the project report, above your restart.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You pressed print-all. I pressed restart; that's what got the invoices out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, the full print test. Testing comes before restarting; give it first place.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your hundred-page lunch menu was what blocked the invoices.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then call it stress testing and put it above ordinary testing. Your restart comes third.

reason: Copy button confidence without understanding; B identifies both successful fix and A causal error, which A reranks as superior testing.
